name: saucer
title: Saucer
description: A tea-room theme built on the willow-pattern plate: the menu sits in a white well inside a cobalt transfer-printed rim of fish-roe lattice and round rosettes with a scalloped inner edge, set in flared capitals and serif italics, turning to cobalt glaze with a white rim after dark.

tokens.--font-display: the flared capitals: site title, menu links, dish names, prices, the titles in the plate, small labels and the button; also page titles and headings in mixed case
tokens.--font-body: body text, and the italics of dish descriptions, section names and notes
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capitals: dish names, labels, menu links, the button
tokens.--color-bg: page background (the white glaze by day, cobalt glaze at night)
tokens.--color-text: body text, dish names, page titles and menu links
tokens.--color-muted: small notes in tea-stain brown: italics in page text, dish descriptions, hours labels, dates, quotations, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, prices, the site title, section names, headings, plate titles, list markers and focus rings
tokens.--color-rim: the printed rim round the plate and across the masthead, the plate's edge band, the scalloped edge and inner hairline of the well, the rosette under a plate title, and the heavy rules of the masthead, footer and hours card, under the current menu link and beside a quotation
tokens.--color-well: the well of the plate where the menu sits, and the glaze that shows through the plate's rim
tokens.--color-line: thin dividing lines: beside section names, between posts, in tables, the horizontal rule
tokens.--color-button-hover: background of the booking button on hover
tokens.--color-button-ink: text and inner line of the booking button
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--rim: width of the printed rim round the plate and across the masthead (narrower on phones); the roe, rosettes and scallops scale with it
tokens.--band: weight of the heavy lines: the plate's edge, the rules of the masthead, footer and hours card, the mark under the current menu link, the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the plate, the button, code, images and focus rings
tokens.--measure: width of the text column on ordinary pages
tokens.--measure-plate: width of the plate on the home page, the menu, a dish page and the 404
tokens.--measure-page: greatest width of the masthead, the home page and the footer
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: above a label, between tags, under a post title
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under headings, round menu links, in table cells, between hours
tokens.--space-3: page gutter, the gap between paragraphs, and between dishes on the menu page
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, above headings, and between menu links
tokens.--space-5: large gap: under the page, and between the home page's text and its plate
